portInfo.description: Montego Bay is a cruise call—confirm your berth on the daily programme before you plan the day.
portInfo.currency: Jamaican Dollar (JMD), US Dollar widely accepted

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Beaches and town are marketed as accessible; walk/shuttle minutes from the cruise gate are unverified. Falmouth and Ocho Rios are separate PAJ ports — do not assume a short hop without a timed coach.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Doctor’s Cave / local beaches — transfer unverified; ~120–180 min ashore block.
Inland falls / estate tours — coach; standard/long call only.
thingsToDo.shortCall: One nearby beach or strip block (~150) + 75 min buffer.
thingsToDo.longerCall: Further island touring with ≥120 min buffer.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Montego Bay Freeport / SEZ addresses on PAJ contact pages are not automatically the cruise gangway — use Mantica Way cruise contact.
